{{Quote|I have another lead. A small-time thug named Gwhirrye Baric. He runs a spice racket out of a small hospital here in Doaba Guerfel.|[[Lilith Laughlin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />}}
'''Gwhirrye Baric''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] small-time thug who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's these rogue CorSec miscreants lead by a bloke named Xyrias Undea. If they were to suddenly disappear so they can't muscle in on my rackets, I reckon my memory might return.|Gwhirrye Baric, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Gwhirrye Baric resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he ran a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] racket out of a small [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of [[Rogue CorSec]] criminals led by [[Xyrias Undea]] harassed his business. Around the same time, a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent working for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] interrogated Baric about a criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]]. The thug begged the agent to deal with his Rogue CorSec problem in exchange for information. The agent thus fought and killed several Rogue CorSec miscreants, including Xyrias Undea. Gwhirrye Baric later agreed with giving information about the spice dealer [[Trins Evnar]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gwhirrye Baric was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gwhirrye Baric was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
